name: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry Ltd.
summary: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and marketing of organic chemistry industry products, organic reagents, petrochemical products, and special polymers in Japan, China, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and Europe. The company operates in three segments: Chemical Products, Electronic Materials, and Functional Chemicals. It offers chemical products, including biomass acrylates and acrylic monomers for coating raw materials and adhesives; and electronics materials, such as display device and semiconductor materials.
